messages:
Leo: Anyone want to bring extra controllers for a mini LAN tonight? thinking Rocket League + Smash.
Anya: I can bring 2 wired Xbox pads and a 1m ethernet.
Sam: I have a Switch Pro and HDMI cable. I'll be late but can join for RL.
Gabe: I can grab a beanbag and power strip. Also have a small 4-port unmanaged switch.
Leo: Sweet — lobby at 19:00 in the back lounge. ops-bot: "Back Lounge" reserved by Leo 18:30-22:00.
Anya: Quick tip: if anyone needs a static for testing local host, use `sudo ifconfig en0 192.168.88.50 netmask 255.255.255.0`.
Sam: Snacks? I'll grab chips.
Gabe: I'll bring cookies.
Leo: Perfect, see you all there :tada:
